ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
ConformAtlas analyses molecular dynamics trajectories: least-squares
superposition, Cartesian/dihedral PCA and TICA, Boltzmann-inverted free
energy landscapes with block-bootstrap uncertainties, watershed state
segmentation with barriers and kinetics, convergence diagnostics
(RMSIP, cosine content, effective sample size, equilibration detection)
and multi-system comparisons in a shared PCA space. Every numerical
component is validated against analytical results or independent
implementations (MDAnalysis, GROMACS, pymbar, deeptime, SciPy, ProDy).
The optional packages weasyprint, plotly, h5py and rich enable the PDF
report, interactive figures, the HDF5 results container and progress bars.
about.summary: Mapping conformational landscapes from molecular simulations

script: conformatlas analyze -s ca_example/WT/topology.pdb -f ca_example/WT/rep1.xtc -f ca_example/WT/rep2.xtc -T 300 --bins 16 --bootstrap 0 --quiet -o ca_example/results

name: conformatlas
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: conformatlas
  version: "1.0.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fd3614481e4c8163a34824f300326262a3c203e0d262cedfe897b1d5beecfd07

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - conformatlas = conformatlas.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.22.0
    - scipy >=1.8.0
    - pandas >=1.4.0
    - matplotlib-base >=3.5.0
    - click >=8.0.0
    - jinja2 >=3.0.0
    - pyyaml >=6.0
    - scikit-image >=0.19.0
    - mdanalysis >=2.2.0
  run_constraints:
    # optional features (PDF report, interactive figures, HDF5 container, progress bars)
    - weasyprint >=59.0
    - plotly >=5.18
    - h5py >=3.6
    - rich >=12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - conformatlas
        - conformatlas.pipeline
        - conformatlas.provenance
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - conformatlas --version
      - conformatlas --help
      - conformatlas doctor
      # end-to-end smoke test on the package's own synthetic dataset (the sdist ships no tests)
      - conformatlas example -o ca_example
      - conformatlas analyze -s ca_example/WT/topology.pdb -f ca_example/WT/rep1.xtc -f ca_example/WT/rep2.xtc -T 300 --bins 16 --bootstrap 0 --quiet -o ca_example/results

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/AtharvaTilewale/ConformAtlas
  summary: Mapping conformational landscapes from molecular simulations
  description: |
    ConformAtlas analyses molecular dynamics trajectories: least-squares
    superposition, Cartesian/dihedral PCA and TICA, Boltzmann-inverted free
    energy landscapes with block-bootstrap uncertainties, watershed state
    segmentation with barriers and kinetics, convergence diagnostics
    (RMSIP, cosine content, effective sample size, equilibration detection)
    and multi-system comparisons in a shared PCA space. Every numerical
    component is validated against analytical results or independent
    implementations (MDAnalysis, GROMACS, pymbar, deeptime, SciPy, ProDy).
    The optional packages weasyprint, plotly, h5py and rich enable the PDF
    report, interactive figures, the HDF5 results container and progress bars.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    # MIT licence of the NGL viewer (ngl.js), shipped as a data file of the HTML report
    - src/conformatlas/templates/assets/NGL_LICENSE.txt
  documentation: https://conformatlas.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/AtharvaTilewale/ConformAtlas

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - AtharvaTilewale
